statements.text: Impression: right-sided cervical radiculopathy secondary to C5-C6 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.
Past surgical history: no prior spine surgery.
MRI cervical spine 09/02/2026: C5-C6 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Baseline NRS prior to any intervention: 8/10.
Symptoms began on 04/07/2026, 23 weeks before this visit.
Completed physical therapy from 04/21/2026 to 05/19/2026 (4 weeks) with no lasting benefit, and failed naproxen 500 mg BID.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Epidural steroid injection history: 2 cervical injections in the past 12 months (11/12/2025, 01/16/2026).
